tenancy.title: Send a letter asking for the deposit
tenancy.note: Give the landlord 7 days to reply. The letter uses only your facts and your agreement.

tenancy.title: Gather what is missing
tenancy.note: Stamp duty certificate, signed inventory list, final bill, dated move-in photos.

tenancy.title: Do the check on the court website
tenancy.note: Answer a few questions on the court website. It gives you a number. Use it within 7 days.

tenancy.title: Fill the claim form and pay
tenancy.note: Log in with Singpass. Fill in your details, the other side, the claim, and a short summary. Upload your files as PDF. Then pick a date for the first court meeting.

tenancy.title: Give the landlord a copy within 7 working days
tenancy.note: Download the copy for the landlord. Hand it to them or send it by registered post. Then tell the court you have done so.

tenancy.title: Before the first court meeting
tenancy.note: The landlord may offer to settle online. Fill in the court form: what happened in date order, and any witnesses. Bring your files in the order of your evidence list.

goods.title: Send a letter to the seller asking for the money
goods.note: Say what is wrong, what you want (refund, repair or replacement) and a date to reply by.

goods.title: Gather what is missing
goods.note: Receipt, listing, dated photos of the fault, a repair quote.

goods.title: Do the check on the court website

goods.title: Fill the claim form and pay

goods.title: Give the seller a copy within 7 working days
goods.note: Download the copy for the seller. Hand it over or send it by registered post. Then tell the court you have done so.

goods.title: Before the first court meeting
goods.note: The seller may offer to settle online. Fill in the court form: what happened in date order, and any witnesses.
